title_en: Regulations of the People's Bank of China on the Monetary Policy Committee

articles.content_en: These Regulations are formulated in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Bank of China in order to facilitate the correct formulation of national monetary policy.

The work of the Monetary Policy Committee shall adhere to the leadership of the Communist Party of China, promote and improve the modern monetary policy framework, and report major matters to the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council.

The Monetary Policy Committee is an advisory and deliberative body for the formulation of monetary policy by the People's Bank of China.
The Monetary Policy Committee shall be formed in accordance with these Regulations.
The Monetary Policy Committee shall perform its functions through plenary meetings.

The members of the Monetary Policy Committee shall include ex officio members and nominated members. The Governor of the People's Bank of China, the Director of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, the Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, and the Administrator of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange shall be ex officio members of the Monetary Policy Committee. The other members of the Monetary Policy Committee shall be nominated members, whose candidates shall be nominated by the People's Bank of China or nominated by the People's Bank of China in consultation with the relevant departments, and submitted to the State Council for appointment.

The Monetary Policy Committee shall have one Chairperson and one Vice Chairperson. The Chairperson shall be assumed by the Governor of the People's Bank of China; the Vice Chairperson shall be designated by the Chairperson.

The term of office of the President of the China Banking Association who is a member of the Monetary Policy Committee shall generally not exceed five years; the term of office of expert members for one term shall not exceed three years, and the maximum term of office shall generally not exceed two terms.
The Monetary Policy Committee shall establish a Secretariat as its permanent office.
The members of the Monetary Policy Committee shall have equal rights and obligations.
The members of the Monetary Policy Committee shall attend the meetings of the Monetary Policy Committee and put forward opinions and suggestions on relevant monetary policy matters.
The members of the Monetary Policy Committee shall perform their duties with due diligence, and shall not abuse their powers or engage in malpractice for personal gain.

The members of the Monetary Policy Committee shall keep state secrets and trade secrets, comply with the working system of the Monetary Policy Committee, and shall not disclose monetary policy and relevant information in violation of regulations.
Where any member of the Monetary Policy Committee leaks state secrets or trade secrets in violation of regulations, the member's post as a member of the Monetary Policy Committee shall be removed, and legal liability shall be pursued according to law.

A member of the Monetary Policy Committee shall not publicly oppose the monetary policy that has been formulated in accordance with statutory procedures during his or her term of office and within one year after leaving office.

The Monetary Policy Committee shall adopt a regular meeting system, with meetings held once every quarter.
The Chairperson of the Monetary Policy Committee or more than one-third of the members jointly may propose to convene an interim meeting.
After the regular meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee, the People's Bank of China shall adopt various methods to strengthen expectation guidance and market communication.
The Secretariat of the Monetary Policy Committee shall deliver the meeting agenda and relevant materials to all members before the convening of the regular meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee.
A meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee may be held only when more than two-thirds of the members are present.

The minutes of the meeting shall be adopted to record the various opinions of the meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee.
A monetary policy proposal submitted by a member of the Monetary Policy Committee shall, after being voted and adopted by more than two-thirds of the members present at the meeting, form a recommendation letter of the Monetary Policy Committee.

When the People's Bank of China submits a decision plan to the State Council for approval concerning matters related to interest rates, exchange rates or other important monetary policy matters, it may submit the recommendation letter of the Monetary Policy Committee or the minutes of the meeting as an attachment together with the plan.
The internal working system of the Monetary Policy Committee shall be formulated by the Monetary Policy Committee.
These Regulations shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
